gloss: to persist with; to stick to; to carry through

definitions.gloss: to persist with; to stick to; to carry through to the end
definitions.explanation: To maintain a stance, belief, or course of action without yielding, no matter what obstacles arise. A compound verb combining {貫|つらぬ}く (to pierce/persist) and {通|とお}す (to pass through/continue).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}す。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}した。

⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧にもかかわらず、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}した。
examples.english: Despite opposition from those around her, she held firm to her beliefs.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧ (to pierce through, to persist) and ⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to pass through, to continue). The combination intensifies the meaning of persistence — not just holding to something, but doing so all the way through to the end.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}す: to stick to one's opinion
- ⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}す: to hold firm to one's beliefs
- ⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}す: to maintain silence throughout
- ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫|つらぬ}き{通|とお}す: to maintain one's stance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to pierce / to persist — the base verb, slightly less emphatic about completion
- ⟦{貫徹|かんてつ}する→貫徹する：22027_kantetsusuru⟧: to carry out thoroughly — more formal, often used with policies or objectives
- ⟦{押|お}し{通|とお}す→押し通す：20718_oshitoosu⟧: to push through — implies forcing something through against resistance
